GB/GBC core copied without modification from manuaguirre9/nw-a820-homebrew, commit 1b480e5dc564d2bf42f562584edbb13b5bc87cc5, homebrew/third_party/gnuboy-master. GPL-2.0, see COPYING. Only the interpreter/LCD/RTC/sound-register core is compiled. No A829 platform, loader, updater or runtime is copied. X1000 frontend and bounded external ROM/save I/O are separate.
